title: Florida man gets fresh chance to challenge copies of dead woman's will after originals go missing
summary_full: Herman Levy is contesting the validity of a will and its codicil, both reportedly lost. A ruling from a Florida appeals court has affirmed Levy's right to pursue his case, enabling him to claim his status as the sole legal heir of Renee Paris in accordance with Florida law. The matter will revert to the lower court for an evaluation regarding the missing documents, potentially impacting the estate's allocation.
